family_handling: REASSEMBLE conference and preprint, TaF-VLA journal and preprint, CoinFT journal and preprint, and the iCub3 nonlinear calibration conference and preprint have one record each. Preprint retrievals establish evidence for the inspected version.
EventTouch data card describes a physical and simulated release; no matching scholarly work was identified on the card. Catalogued data and standalone literature are counted separately.
A press, a fingertip transducer, an iCub limb, and a loaded industrial wrist have different geometries and calibration ranges; their reported accuracy measures cannot be pooled.
limitations: Targeted, free sources; no claim of exhaustive coverage, common-origin calibrated truth or a new raw file from a citation alone.

No incoming work was counted as a robot wrist calibration or assembly trial.
